label: How Agents open
hint: Where an Agent or a task opens when you click it in a chat. Side panel keeps the chat next to it; in a phone-sized window it covers the chat. Full page opens it on its own page, with a way back to the chat. Applies to this browser only.
busy_send_hint: For supported TRAE and Antigravity terminals in this browser. Queue waits for a new turn. Follow Up sends sooner; in Antigravity it sends the whole queue.
